protocol.scope: Wall time of Vakint::evaluate in Retain mode, in a fresh process, input parsed, engine (and RustRed library) loaded and the one-loop bubble evaluated once beforehand by either backend, on directories of its own: same frontend and finalizer for both backends. RustRed cold: empty ordered-cache directory, shipped caches off. Warm-same: fresh process replaying a read-only copy of the cache its cold run filled. Warm-shared: per L one chain over the cells in table order sharing one cache from empty. Forcer cold: private empty materialisation directory; warm: materialised (Forcer has no result cache). Raw: the generated FORM programs run directly, one FORM process each. OS pages are not flushed.
